segment.source: IMPERIAL PURSUIT The Empire pursues the Rebels as they flee Yavin base.
segment.target: 帝國追擊 帝國艦隊向逃離雅汶基地的 反抗軍發動瘋狂追擊。

segment.source: Tour of Duty IV IMPERIAL PURSUIT
segment.target: 第四輪執勤 帝國追擊

segment.source:
Having achieved its greatest victory by destroying the Empire's dreaded Death Star, the Rebellion gains new allies. Emperor Palpatine, furious at his defeat has sent a huge armada to destroy the Rebel base at Yavin.
Despite their new strength, the Alliance can not withstand another attack from the Imperial fleet and must flee their base.
segment.target:
反抗軍摧毀了帝國恐怖的死星，贏得空前偉大勝利，並迎來了眾多新盟友加入。
然而白卜庭皇帝對這場慘敗勃然大怒，隨即派遣一支無比龐大的復仇艦隊前來剿滅雅汶的反抗軍基地。
儘管實力大增，反抗軍同盟依然無法正面抵禦帝國大軍的毀滅性圍剿，全軍被迫撤離基地展開生死大逃亡……

segment.source: Escort Alliance Corvettes carrying base personnel in the evacuation of Yavin.
segment.target: 在雅汶基地大撤退行動中， 為載運基地人員的 同盟巡邏艦隊提供護航。
>行動 1：護送逃離雅汶的巡邏艦隊

segment.source: Though Alliance losses were severe, the [[Death Star's ]]destruction was a great victory. Even so, there is little time for celebration. With the Empire's discovery of our secret base on [[Yavin]], we find ourselves on the run again.$ All personnel on [[Yavin]] must be evacuated. There cannot be much time left before an Imperial invasion force arrives. Alliance Command is asking for help from the [[Defiance]].
segment.target: 儘管同盟蒙受了慘重損失，但[[死星]]的徹底毀滅無疑是一場扭轉乾坤的偉大勝利。然而，我們根本沒有時間慶祝。隨著帝國發現了我們在[[雅汶]]的秘密基地，我們再度踏上了逃亡之路。$ [[雅汶]]基地的全體人員必須火速撤離。在帝國登陸入侵艦隊大舉壓境前，時間已所剩無幾。同盟司令部正向[[挑釁號]]請求緊急空中支援。

segment.source: A-Wing[[ Red One]] will escort Alliance Corvettes in the evacuation of [[Yavin]].
segment.target: A翼戰機[[紅一號]]將在[[雅汶]]撤退行動中負責為同盟巡邏艦隊護航。

segment.source: Stay alert and ready for an Imperial attack on our fleeing ships.
segment.target: 隨時保持警惕，準備迎擊帝國對我方撤退艦船發動的致命突襲。

segment.source: This convoy is carrying the last of our personnel from the [[Yavin Base]].
segment.target: 這支護航船隊正載運著最後一批撤離[[雅汶基地]]的人員。

segment.source: Our fleet is now scattering throughout the galaxy. Escape and survival are our main concern.$ Welcome back, we all missed you. Your starfighter is the only one available to see five Corvettes safely to their jump point. They will take about [[17]] minutes to reach it. Glad to have you aboard, Red One!
segment.target: 全同盟艦隊正化整為零散布至全銀河各處。成功脫險與全力生存是我們當前唯一的目標。$ 歡迎歸隊，我們所有人都深切期盼著你！目前唯有你的戰機能負責掩護五艘巡邏艦安全抵達超空間跳躍點。它們大約需要[[17]]分鐘才能抵達。慶幸有你加入，紅一號！

segment.source: T/Bs are the main threat. Don't let them launch their torpedoes. There are 3 sets of 4 T/Bs followed by 2 sets of 3 T/Bs. Engage T/Bs as close to the FRG as possible, but stay out of the FRG's gun range.$ You will be harassed by a pair of T/Fs (with 1 replacement wave). Evade them whenever T/Bs are present. Kill them when convenient.$
segment.target: 鈦式轟炸機（T/B）是最大威脅，絕不能讓它們發射魚雷。敵軍將出動 3 波各 4 架轟炸機，隨後是 2 波各 3 架轟炸機。盡可能在靠近巡防艦處攔截轟炸機，但務必保持在巡防艦的防空射程之外。$ 一對鈦戰機（T/F）將持續騷擾你（並有 1 波增援）。轟炸機在場時先規避戰機，待空檔時再將其擊落。$

segment.source: There will be four Freighters loaded with foodstuffs retreating ahead of you. If they come under attack, you are to remain with [[Crescent]] Squadron. Our personnel are more important than our supplies!$
segment.target: 有四艘滿載口糧物資的貨船正走在你前方撤退。若它們遭到攻擊，你必須堅守在[[新月（Crescent）]]中隊身邊。我軍人員的性命重於物資！$

segment.source: THANKS FOR YOUR HELP, RED ONE!
segment.target: 最後一批撤離人員已全數安然脫離戰場！

segment.source: IT'S GOOD TO SEE YOU BACK IN THE BATTLE!
segment.target: 紅一號，全體同仁對你的掩護感激不盡！
我們絕對需要你的超凡身手

segment.source: Protect Alliance forces as they head to their jump points during the retreat from Yavin.
segment.target: 掩護多支同盟船隊 前往預設跳躍點， 自雅汶撤退。

segment.source: There will be two groups of Transports (three in each), one group of three Shuttles and two Freighters. You must ensure that they all escape to safety.$ There are a pair of Nav Buoys to mark the entrance and exit jump points. Patrol this area and intercept any Imperial attackers.
segment.target: 撤退部隊包括兩組運輸船隊（每組三艘）、一組三艘的太空梭群以及兩艘貨船。你必須確保所有船隻安全撤離。$ 空域中設有一對導航衛星用以標示進場與離場的超空間跳躍點。在此區域巡邏並攔截任何帝國突襲者。

segment.source: Alliance forces are fleeing [[Yavin]]. This is one of the escape routes.
segment.target: 同盟各部正全力撤出[[雅汶]]。此處為主要撤退航道之一。

segment.source: The convoy's entry and exit points are marked with Nav Buoys.
segment.target: 船隊的進場與離場點均由導航衛星進行標示。

segment.source: Two X-wings will be sent ahead to guard a transit point on their path.
segment.target: 兩架 X翼戰機將提前部署，負責守衛撤退路線上的中繼點。

segment.source: As you may have noted during the last mission, most of the Alliance Fleet's food supply was destroyed by the Empire. This is cause for grave concern, but first we must continue to evade Imperial forces.$ As soon as two X-wings from [[Red]] Squadron are ready, you will be sent back out to aid more of our fleeing ships. A transit point along their retreat route needs guarding.
segment.target: 你可能在上次任務中注意到了，同盟艦隊的大部分糧食儲備已被帝國摧毀。這引發了嚴重的物資危機，但當前首要之務仍是徹底甩開帝國追兵。$ 一旦[[紅隊]]的兩架 X翼戰機整裝完畢，你將再次出擊支援更多撤退艦船。撤退航線上的一處關鍵轉運點需要你嚴加看守。

segment.source: Watch for the arrival of enemy TRNs at [[5]] and [[12 ]]minutes into the mission. They carry torpedoes and launch at the Freighters. Use duel torpedoes on the first three, then finish off the fourth with lasers.$ The GUN pairs enter on the destruction of the previous. So kill one GUN fast then play with its wingman. If you are doing good, two pairs of GUNs will enter. A STD will enter, too late and far away.
segment.target: 注意在任務開始後第 [[5]] 分鐘與第 [[12]] 分鐘躍入的敵軍運輸船（TRN）。它們攜帶質子魚雷且專門瞄準我方貨船。對前三艘敵運輸船使用雙發魚雷齊射，再用雷射砲解決第四艘。$ 敵突擊砲艇（GUN）均在上一組被消滅後進場。因此快速擊落一架砲艇後，可與僚機周旋拖延時間。滅星者（STD）雖會進場，但距離過遠且為時已晚。

segment.source: The convoy is made up of four groups of ships.
segment.target: 撤退護航船隊由四組不同船隻組成。

segment.source: You are to remain on station until relieved by X-wing [[Blue]].
segment.target: 堅守崗位，直到[[藍隊]] X翼戰機前來交班換防。
撤退船隊已全數安全脫離！

segment.source: X-WING BLUE HAS ARRIVED TO RELIEVE YOU
segment.target: 恭喜你圓滿達成任務，紅一號！
返航基地準備執行下一項任務
撤離馬克西姆斯號巡洋艦

segment.source: The Alliance Cruiser Maximus has been caught in an Imperial ambush. Help rescue its crew from impending catastrophe.
segment.target: 巡洋艦馬克西姆斯號遭遇伏擊。 掩護逃生太空梭與運輸船 抵達超空間跳躍點。
>行動 3：馬克西姆斯號遭遇伏擊

segment.source: CRS [[Maximus]] is caught in an Imperial ambush and can't hold out for long.
segment.target: 巡洋艦[[馬克西姆斯號]]深陷帝國伏擊圈，已支撐不了多久。

segment.source: The Imperial STD [[Nihil]] is inflicting a savage beating and launching TIEs.
segment.target: 帝國滅星者[[虛無號（Nihil）]]正實施狂轟濫炸並出動大批鈦戰機。

segment.source: As many of the crew as possible will try to escape in SHUs and TRNs.
segment.target: 盡可能掩護全艦人員搭乘太空梭與運輸船逃生。

segment.source: The Alliance Frigate[[ Anvil]] will precede the others to a safe location.
segment.target: 同盟巡防艦[[鐵砧號（Anvil）]]將先行撤往安全空域。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will come to the aid of A-wing [[Blue]] to screen their withdrawal.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]將馳援 A翼[[藍隊]]，為撤離行動構築阻擊屏障。

segment.source: In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Alliance fleet has scattered as they flee to escape destruction. One unfortunate task force led by the Cruiser [[Maximus]] has been caught in an Imperial ambush.$ The [[Maximus's]] crew has begun to abandon ship. The remnants of [[Blue]] Squadron's A-wings are making a last ditch effort to protect their withdrawal. You are to hyperspace to their aid immediately.
segment.target: 在[[雅汶戰役]]落幕後，同盟艦隊在逃亡避禍中四散撤退。由巡洋艦[[馬克西姆斯號]]率領的一支不幸特遣隊慘遭帝國艦隊設伏圍攻。$ [[馬克西姆斯號]]官兵已開始全體棄艦。[[藍隊]]殘存的 A翼戰機正拼死進行最後的掩護阻擊。你必須立即跳入超空間前往馳援！

segment.source: You are to ensure that all escaping [[Shuttles]] and [[Transports]] make it to the jump point. Imperial forces will be in pursuit. Move as quickly as you can to intercept any enemy starfighters.$ The Empire isn't just trying to crush the Rebellion now. They want revenge for the loss of the [[Death Star]]! The [[Emperor]] is more determined than ever to exterminate the Alliance once and for all!
segment.target: 你必須確保所有逃生的[[太空梭]]與[[運輸船]]平安抵達跳躍點。帝國追兵正蜂擁而至，務必全速攔截敵方戰機。$ 帝國現在不僅僅是想鎮壓叛軍，他們更渴望為[[死星]]的毀滅展開血腥復仇！[[皇帝]]比以往任何時刻都更堅決地誓要徹底滅絕同盟！

segment.source: Only the Shuttles are in any real danger. To reach them ASAP, redirect shield power to the engines to get your speed up to at least [[112]].$ T/F Theta is the greatest threat to the SHUs. T/Bs Alpha and Delta will also target them once the [[Maximus]] is destroyed.$ You will be attacked by T/F Gamma and T/Is Beta and Eta. Engage only when no enemy is attacking the Shuttles.
segment.target: 只有太空梭處於真正的致命危險中。為盡快趕到它們身邊，將護盾能量全數轉移至發動機，將航速推至至少 [[112]]。$ 鈦戰機西塔組是太空梭的最大威脅。一旦[[馬克西姆斯號]]沉沒，阿爾法與德爾塔轟炸機亦會轉向攻擊太空梭。$ 敵鈦戰機伽瑪組與截擊機貝塔、艾塔組將圍攻你，唯有在敵機未威脅太空梭時才與其交火。

segment.source: YOU DID ALL YOU COULD, RED ONE, LET'S GO HOME
segment.target: 馬克西姆斯號全體生還人員已安全撤離！

segment.source: THE LOSS OF THE MAXIMUS IS A TERRIBLE SETBACK!
segment.target: 在如此慘烈的圍攻下完成掩護，真是了不起的壯舉！

segment.source: AT LEAST WE SAVED AS MUCH OF THE CREW AS WE COULD
segment.target: 至少我們盡可能挽救了大部分船員

segment.source: Protect the Alliance Frigate Anvil while it receives needed supplies.
segment.target: 巡防艦鐵砧號正進行 緊急物資補給。 在轉運期間為兩艦提供掩護。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] and X-wing [[Gold]] will fly a defensive patrol of the area.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]與 X翼[[金隊]]將在該空域執行防空巡邏。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] and X-wing [[Gold]] are to provide area security during the operation. The transfer will take [[four]] minutes and then both ships will jump into hyperspace.$ Be prepared to intercept any Imperial attack. The [[Anvil]] has only two A-wings left on board. They are out of missiles, though, so will not be as effective.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]與 X翼[[金隊]]將在轉運期間提供防區安全掩護。轉運作業將耗時[[四]]分鐘，隨後兩艘主力艦將跳入超空間。$ 隨時準備攔截任何帝國攻擊。[[鐵砧號]]艦載戰機僅剩最後兩架 A翼，且其飛彈已全數耗盡，戰力極其受限。

segment.source: The Alliance Frigate [[Anvil]] is in desperate need of resupply.
segment.target: 同盟巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]極度匱乏補給物資。

segment.source: The Corvette [[Lauhu]] will arrive soon to deliver these supplies.
segment.target: 巡邏艦[[勞胡號（Lauhu）]]稍後即將抵達運送物資。

segment.source: The attack begins with a group of four GUNs. Destroy them ASAP.$ The Imperial FRG makes three attack runs. 3 T/Bs and 3 T/Is are launched during each of the first two. On the third attack two groups of two T/Bs each are launched. Each has two follow up waves.$ The Bombers are the primary threat. Ignore the Interceptors until all Bombers are destroyed.$
segment.target: 敵軍突擊始於一組四架突擊砲艇（GUN）。務必第一時間消滅之。$ 帝國巡防艦發起三次進攻。在前兩次中，各出動 3 架轟炸機與 3 架截擊機；在第三次進攻中，則出動兩組各 2 架轟炸機（每組有 2 波後續增援）。$ 轟炸機是頭號威脅！在所有轟炸機被消滅前，切勿分心攻擊截擊機。$

segment.source: The loss of the [[Maximus]] is the most serious blow the Alliance has suffered since [[Yavin]]. The Frigate [[Anvil]] is another ship from the same task force whose crew has fought well but taken heavy losses.$ The [[Anvil's]] situation is precarious. The Corvette [[Lauhu]] will arrive moments after you to deliver supplies. If this operation is disrupted, the [[Anvil]] will not survive another attack.
segment.target: [[馬克西姆斯號]]的沉沒是同盟自[[雅汶戰役]]以來蒙受的最沉重打擊。巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]來自同一支特遣編隊，官兵英勇奮戰但傷亡慘重。$ [[鐵砧號]]情勢極其危急。巡邏艦[[勞胡號]]將在你抵達後不久進場轉運物資。若轉運遭到破壞，鐵砧號將絕對無法承受下一次打擊。

segment.source: THE ANVIL HAS ESCAPED, RETURN TO BASE
segment.target: 補給轉運圓滿成功，兩艦已安全進入超空間！

segment.source: GOOD SHOOTING, RED TWO, THANKS FOR YOUR HELP!
segment.target: 出色的護航作戰，紅一號！

segment.source: The Frigate Anvil is hopelessly damaged and must be abandoned. Guard the evacuation, then scuttle the ship.
segment.target: 巡防艦鐵砧號已無法挽救。 掩護人員撤離，並將該艦自沉， 以防落入帝國手中。

segment.source: The Frigate [[Anvil]] was severely mauled while trying to receive supplies.
segment.target: 巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]在先前的補給行動中遭受重創。

segment.source: The Frigate [[Anvil]] was so badly damaged during the last attack that it barely escaped. Now it must be abandoned and scuttled.$ The Corvette [[Hart]] and three Transports will arrive to pick up the [[Anvil's]] surviving crew. This will take about [[7]] minutes.$ As soon as the [[Hart]] has completed docking, [[Red One]] is to destroy the [[Anvil ]]to prevent its capture by the Empire.
segment.target: 巡防艦[[鐵砧號]]在上波進攻中傷勢過重，僅能勉強脫離戰場。如今該艦已無力搶修，必須予以棄艦自沉。$ 巡邏艦[[哈特號（Hart）]]與三艘運輸船即將抵達接運[[鐵砧號]]的生還官兵。撤離將耗時約 [[7]] 分鐘。$ 一旦[[哈特號]]完成對接撤離，[[紅一號]]必須徹底摧毀[[鐵砧號]]，絕不可讓其落入帝國魔掌！

segment.source: There isn't time to repair the ship so now it must be abandoned.
segment.target: 敵軍步步進逼，已無時間維修，必須立即棄艦自沉。

segment.source: The Corvette [[Hart]] and several Transports will evacuate the crew.
segment.target: 巡邏艦[[哈特號]]與數艘運輸船將負責疏散全體官兵。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] [[One]] will then scuttle the [[Anvil]] to prevent it being captured.
segment.target: X翼戰機[[紅一號]]隨後將親手擊沉[[鐵砧號]]以防被敵軍俘獲。

segment.source: Then escort the evacuation ships to the jump point. Y-wing [[Gold]] will help.
segment.target: 隨後護送撤離艦隊前往跳躍點。Y翼[[金隊]]將協助掩護。

segment.source: You must ensure that Corvette [[Hart]] and all Transports escape to safety. Two Y-wings from [[Gold]] Squadron are available if attacked.$ Imperial Corvette Squadron [[Viper]] is patrolling this sector in search of the [[Anvil's ]]task force. Their orders are to hunt down and kill all fleeing Alliance forces.$ Also, many squadrons of Assault Gunboats have fanned out through the sector as advance scouts.
segment.target: 你必須確保巡邏艦[[哈特號]]與所有運輸船安全脫離。若遭遇攻擊，來自[[金隊]]的兩架 Y翼戰機可供調遣。$ 帝國巡邏艦中隊[[毒蛇（Viper）]]正在此星區巡弋搜捕[[鐵砧號]]特遣隊，其受令格殺所有逃亡反抗軍部隊。$ 此外，大批突擊砲艇亦已在此星區展開前哨偵察。

segment.source: Intercept and destroy GUN Mu ASAP. When CRV [[Viper 7]] enters, order your wingmen to attack. Use 2 torps yourself.$ Take out TRNs next then finish off the [[Anvil]]. Catch up with the [[Hart]].$ Destroy [[Viper 1]] as far from the [[Hart]] as possible. Use remaining 4 torps and wingmen assist. Then into [[Viper 2's]] blind spot to kill. Order wingmen to attack incoming waves of GUN Tau.
segment.target: 第一時間攔截並消滅突擊砲艇繆組。當敵巡邏艦[[毒蛇 7 號]]進場時，命令僚機全力圍攻，你自己使用 2 枚魚雷。$ 接著消滅敵運輸船，隨後補火擊沉[[鐵砧號]]，全速趕上[[哈特號]]。$ 盡可能在遠離[[哈特號]]處擊毀[[毒蛇 1 號]]（使用剩餘 4 枚魚雷並讓僚機協助）。隨後切入[[毒蛇 2 號]]的射擊死角將其擊沉。命令僚機阻擊來襲的陶組砲艇。

segment.source: THE ANVIL'S CREW IS SAFE, GOOD WORK
segment.target: 鐵砧號已被自沉，所有撤離人員均已安全跳入超空間！

segment.source: THANKS FOR YOUR HELP, NOW RETURN TO BASE
segment.target: 任務圓滿達成，痛惜鐵砧號的犧牲，但英雄永垂不朽！

segment.source: Guard a Rebel Alliance Freighter during repair operations. Its cargo is essential to the Rebellion.
segment.target: 貨船歐普穆斯號故障拋錨， 正在深空中緊急維修。 掩護該船免遭帝國突襲。

segment.source: Our Freighter [[Op Mus]] has been disabled and is awaiting repairs.
segment.target: 我方貨船[[歐普穆斯號（Op Mus）]]已癱瘓拋錨，正等待維修。

segment.source: Two X-wings from[[ Red Squadron ]]will be sent to guard the repair operation.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]所屬的兩架 X翼戰機將奉命掩護搶修作業。

segment.source: As you know the escape from [[Yavin]] has been fraught with difficulties and setbacks. Our food stocks are critically low. It is imperative that we protect any remaining supplies.$ The Freighter [[Op Mus]] is carrying a load of grain that represents the bulk of these supplies. Unfortunately, [[Op Mus]] has broken down in deep space!$ [[Red]] Squadron will send two X-wings to guard over it.
segment.target: 如你所知，逃離[[雅汶]]的旅程充滿了千難萬險。我們的糧食儲備已降至崩潰邊緣，必須全力保全殘存的每一份物資。$ 貨船[[歐普穆斯號]]載運的糧食代表了這批物資的命脈所在。不幸的是，該船在深空航行中引擎故障！$ [[紅隊]]將出動兩架 X翼戰機前往警戒看守。

segment.source: Transport [[Jaamn]] is en route and will deliver a repair crew within moments.
segment.target: 運輸船[[賈姆恩號（Jaamn）]]正全速趕來，數分鐘內即可送達維修隊。

segment.source: The Transport [[Jaamn]] will deliver a repair crew moments after you pop out of hyperspace. The repairs will take approximately [[10]] minutes.$ X-wing [[Red]] is to protect the repair operation from Imperial attack.$ The Empire isn't our only enemy now. We're also threatened by starvation! This grain is essential to the survival of the Alliance.
segment.target: 運輸船[[賈姆恩號]]將在你脫離超空間後立刻送達搶修團隊。維修作業約需耗時 [[10]] 分鐘。$ X翼[[紅隊]]必須全程保護維修作業免受帝國突襲。$ 帝國已不是我們唯一的敵人，饑荒正嚴重威脅著同盟的存亡！這批糧食是全體同盟戰士生存的唯一希望！

segment.source: You will be attacked by many groups of GUNs. Whenever ships have waves, or enter on the destruction of a previous group, kill all but one in a group. Then play with the last ship. This will slow the arrival of the next group. $ Neutral FRTs and Y-Ws will appear 7:20 minutes after the mission starts. Ignore them and continue to go after the GUNs. The Y-Ws may help you against the GUNs.
segment.target: 你將遭受多批突擊砲艇（GUN）的輪番攻擊。每當敵機有接替波次或在前一組被毀後進場時，先擊落其僚機並留下最後一架周旋，這能大幅延遲下一組敵機的進場時間。$ 中立貨船與 Y翼戰機將在任務開始 7 分 20 秒後出現。無視貨船並專心獵殺砲艇；Y翼戰機或許能協助你反抗砲艇。

歐普穆斯號搶修完畢，珍貴糧食保全無損！

segment.source: HEAD HOME BEFORE MORE IMPERIAL FORCES ARRIVE
segment.target: 反抗軍全體戰士向你的英勇護航致敬！

segment.source: Protect a vital supply container while an Alliance transport recovers it.
segment.target: 一具裝滿糧食的貨櫃 被遺留在小普魯里奧星團。 掩護貨船回收該貨櫃。

segment.source: As we continue to evade the Empire's pursuit our survival becomes ever more doubtful. Because of the loss of most of our food supplies it is imperative that we find new sources.$ In the meantime there is one lost cache of grain available to us. It is in a Cargo Container in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]. The Container was dropped by one of our ships in an attempt to elude an Imperial attack.
segment.target: 隨著我們持續規避帝國追剿，全軍的生存危機愈發嚴峻。由於失去了大部分口糧儲備，尋找新食物來源刻不容緩。$ 眼下有一處遺落的糧食儲備尚可爭取：位於[[小普魯里奧星團（Lesser Plooriod Cluster）]]的一具貨物貨櫃。該貨櫃是在我們先前一艘艦船為擺脫帝國追擊時被迫拋下的。

segment.source: A Container full of grain was dropped in the [[Lesser]] [[Plooriod Cluster]].
segment.target: 一具裝滿糧食的貨物貨櫃遺留於[[小普魯里奧星團]]。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] will jump to this location immediately to protect it.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]將立刻跳入該座標實施防衛。

segment.source: Our Freighter [[Trips]] is to retrieve the grain and will arrive in [[7]] minutes.
segment.target: 我方貨船[[特里普斯號（Trips）]]將前往回收糧食，[[7]] 分鐘內抵達。

segment.source: The retrieval itself will only take [[2]] minutes and then the [[Trips]] will leave.
segment.target: 回收作業僅需 [[2]] 分鐘，隨後[[特里普斯號]]將立即脫離。

segment.source: The ship's commander was unaware of our overall supply situation. The Freighter [[Trips]] is being sent to retrieve the grain before it is destroyed by Imperial forces.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send two X-wings to intercept any attacking Imperials. When the [[Trips]] arrives X-wing [[Red]] will be responsible for defending the operation from Imperial attack.
segment.target: 當時拋棄貨櫃的艦長並不知曉全軍的物資危機。貨船[[特里普斯號]]已被派出，搶在帝國部隊摧毀它之前回收糧食。$ [[紅隊]]將出動兩架 X翼戰機攔截所有進犯帝國敵機。特里普斯號抵達時，X翼[[紅隊]]將全權負責防衛整場回收作業。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] must ensure the completion of this transfer.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]必須竭力保證此項物資回收圓滿完成。

segment.source: A FRG has already launched 4 T/Fs and 4 T/Bs. Move to intercept T/F Alpha, but not too quickly. Stay within 8 klicks of the Container you are protecting.$ A specially modified CRV will pop up 3:18 minutes into the mission. 48 seconds later it will launch a single T/B (with 2 replacements). Use your torpedoes in dual fire mode to destroy the CRV before the T/B is launched, then go after T/B Beta.
segment.target: 一艘帝國巡防艦已出動 4 架鈦戰機與 4 架鈦式轟炸機。前去攔截鈦戰機阿爾法組，但切勿跑得過遠，務必留在離目標貨櫃 8 公里以內。$ 任務開始 3 分 18 秒後，一艘特製巡邏艦將躍入戰場，並在 48 秒後出動單架轟炸機（有 2 波替補）。在巡邏艦出動轟炸機前，切換質子魚雷雙發齊射徹底將其擊沉，隨後立刻追擊貝塔組轟炸機。

segment.source: THE VITAL GRAIN SUPPLY HAS BEEN RECOVERED
segment.target: 糧食貨櫃已回收完畢，特里普斯號安全返航！

segment.source: THIS WILL KEEP THE REBELLION ALIVE A LITTLE LONGER
segment.target: 這批關鍵口糧拯救了同盟無數戰士的性命！

segment.source: Capture vital grain supplies by hiding in an asteroid field and ambushing an Imperial convoy.
segment.target: 藏匿於殘骸碎片群中， 伏擊帝國補給艦隊， 搶奪糧食運輸船。

segment.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will hide in this debris cluster to ambush an Imperial convoy.
segment.target: Y翼戰機[[紅一號]]將隱蔽於此殘骸碎片群中，伏擊帝國船隊。

segment.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will hide in the cluster. A convoy is due moments after [[Red One]] takes position. Our intelligence indicates that at least one Transport in the convoy will be carrying food.$ [[Red One]] will identify and disable this ship. Transport [[Raider ]]and X-Wing [[Gold]] will then drop out of hyperspace and the food will be taken. [[Red]] and [[Gold]] will protect the operation from Imperial counterattack.
segment.target: Y翼戰機[[紅一號]]將隱蔽於碎片群內。一隊船隊將在紅一號就位後隨即抵達。情報指出，船隊中至少有一艘運輸船滿載口糧。$ [[紅一號]]必須辨識並以離子砲癱瘓該船。隨後運輸船[[突擊者號（Raider）]]與 X翼[[金隊]]將跳出超空間接管糧食。[[紅隊]]與[[金隊]]將掩護整個作戰免遭敵軍反撲。

segment.source: Amongst the convoy is at least one Imperial [[Transport]] loaded with food.
segment.target: 護航船隊中至少有一艘載運糧食的帝國[[運輸船]]。

segment.source: [[Red One]] must identify and disable any Transport carrying food.
segment.target: [[紅一號]]必須辨識並以離子砲癱瘓任何載有糧食的運輸船。

segment.source: Transport [[Raider]] will then deliver a commando team to capture the food.
segment.target: 運輸船[[突擊者號]]隨後將運送特戰小組實施登艦奪取糧食。

segment.source: Additional cover for the raid will be provided by two X-wings from [[Gold]].
segment.target: 來自[[金隊]]的兩架 X翼戰機將為此次突襲提供額外空中掩護。

segment.source: [[Red]] and [[Gold]] must keep Imperial forces at bay during the raid.
segment.target: 在突擊奪糧期間，[[紅隊]]與[[金隊]]必須全力將帝國守軍拒於門外。

segment.source: [[Supply and Ordnance Command]] has determined that our situation is critical. Our food supply is desperately low. Therefore, a series of raids to steal Imperial food supplies is being planned.$ One of our probes is monitoring traffic near an Imperial Nav Buoy. The Nav Buoy is located to guide ships past a small cluster of debris. This cluster offers an ideal location from which to mount an ambush.
segment.target: [[後勤與軍械司令部]]認定當前局勢極其危急，糧食儲備已見底。因此，我們正策劃一系列針對帝國後勤的奪糧襲擊。$ 我方探測器正在帝國導航衛星附近監控交通。該浮標旨在引導船隻繞過一處小型殘骸碎片群，此處正是設伏的絕佳隱蔽點。

segment.source: The TRN with the grain is Kappa 6. (It is the sixth TRN in the target list as you cycle forward on the CMD.) It will arrive with 5 other TRNs 2:06 minutes into the mission.$ Identifying it triggers the arrival of 3 SHUs which will attack you. Also, 3 GUNs will arrive to attack you 4 minutes later.
segment.target: 載有糧食的目標運輸船為卡帕 6 號（在戰鬥多功能顯示幕 CMD 上向前切換目標時的第 6 艘 TRN）。它將在任務開始 2 分 06 秒後與其他 5 艘運輸船一同進場。$ 辨識該船將觸發 3 艘攻擊你的太空梭進場。此外，4 分鐘後還會有 3 架突擊砲艇前來圍攻你。

segment.source: OUR COMMANDOS HAVE RECOVERED THE FOOD SUPPLY
segment.target: 糧食運輸船已被成功俘獲！

segment.source: IT ISN'T A HUGE TAKE, BUT IT WILL HELP!
RETURN TO BASE, BEFORE IMPERIAL REINFORCEMENTS ARRIVE
segment.target: 在帝國增援部隊抵達前，儘快返航基地

segment.source: Clear a minefield that the Empire has placed around a hyperspace jump point that Alliance convoys use.
segment.target: 帝國在關鍵中繼點布設了水雷。 駕駛 Y翼戰機火速肅清雷區， 確保同盟船隊通行。

segment.source: The Empire has deployed a mine field around one of our Navigational Buoys.
segment.target: 帝國在我軍的一座導航衛星周圍布設了密集水雷陣。

segment.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] must clear the mine field as quickly as possible.
segment.target: Y翼戰機[[紅一號]]必須以最快速度肅清該水雷陣。

segment.source: [[Ghorin]] is known to be a heavy handed ruler with no small similarity to the [[Emperor]], so this is suspicious. Nevertheless, our situation is desperate enough that we must consider his offer.$ An initial shipment is to be delivered to us at a transit point near the edge of [[Ghorin's]] domain. We have just learned that this area was recently mined and a few of our ships were lost there.
segment.target: [[格霍林]]是出了名的鐵腕獨裁者，作風與[[皇帝]]無異，此番行徑極為可疑。儘管如此，我們嚴峻的糧荒逼得我們不得不審慎評估其提議。$ 首批物資原定於格霍林領地邊緣的一處中繼點交付。但我們剛剛獲悉該空域近期被布設了密集水雷，我軍已有數艘船隻在該處觸雷沉沒。

segment.source: This transit point is vital to our plans and must be kept open.
segment.target: 此中繼轉運點關乎我軍大計，絕不可被阻斷封鎖。

segment.source: Several Alliance ships are already en route and can not be recalled.
segment.target: 多艘同盟艦船已在航向該處的途中，無法及時召回！

segment.source: Our food shortage continues to be a serious problem. There appears to be a solution, though. We have been negotiating with [[Overlord Ghorin]], ruler of the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]].$ The [[Plooriods]] contain several agricultural worlds that are major grain exporters. In fact, [[Ghorin]] has been the principal supplier to the Empire in this sector. Now he claims to have grown sympathetic to the Rebellion.
segment.target: 糧荒問題依舊嚴峻。所幸一線轉機出現了：我們正與[[大普魯里奧星團（Greater Plooriod Cluster）]]的統治者——[[格霍林霸主（Overlord Ghorin）]]展開談判。$ 普魯里奧星團坐擁數個主要糧食出口的農業星球。事實上，格霍林一直以來都是該星區帝國軍的主要糧商，如今他卻宣稱同情反抗軍同盟。

segment.source: [[Red]] Squadron is therefore ordered to send a Y-wing to clear the mine field immediately. Several Alliance ships are already en route and can not be recalled. The first of them will arrive less than[[ 7]] minutes after [[Red One]] gets there so you will have be quick!
segment.target: 因此，[[紅隊]]奉命派遣一架 Y翼戰機立即前往排雷。數艘同盟船隻已在途中且無法召回。首艘船將在[[紅一號]]抵達後不到 [[7]] 分鐘內進場，你必須爭分奪秒！

segment.source: Switch to lowest detail. You must be quick to prevent losses to the friendly ships arriving later.$ Use a few torps on your way in. Get as close as you can, remember supercharged lasers fire further (1.5 klicks), but even one normal charged blast will do. Every shot counts so be sure you've got a "green lock".$ Jink and weave between shots. Disengage to recharge, use remaining torpedoes as you reengage.
segment.target: 將畫質切換至最低以提高畫面流暢度。你必須神速排雷，以防後續友軍船隻觸雷。$ 進場時使用數枚魚雷。盡可能貼近水雷，超載雷射砲射程更遠（1.5 公里），但普通雷射單發亦可摧毀水雷。確保「綠色鎖定」後再開火。$ 在開火間隙蛇行擺脫砲火；脫離交火充能護盾，重回戰局時再發射剩餘魚雷。

segment.source: THE JUMP POINT AREA HAS BEEN CLEARED
OUR SHIPS CAN USE THIS VITAL ROUTE FOR THE TIME BEING
segment.target: 所有友軍艦船均平安通過該空域！

segment.source: Destroy an Imperial communications network that is placed to eavesdrop on Alliance convoy operations.
segment.target: 摧毀薩希林迪爾附近興建中的 帝國監聽站， 調虎離山以掩護友軍艦隊動向。

segment.source: [[Red One]] will lead the raid. Use your X-wing to clear the minefield and destroy the Communication Satellite. Once this is done you should prepare to intercept any Imperial response.$ [[Blue]] Squadron will provide four Y-wings to attack the minelaying Corvettes and any other vessels that show up.$
segment.target: 摧毀帝國通訊衛星與周邊水雷陣。

segment.source: Four Y-wings from [[Blue]] Squadron will attack the Corvettes.
segment.target: 這場佯攻將吸引帝國注意力，掩護我軍與格霍林霸主的秘密會晤。

segment.source: X-wing[[ Red One ]]will clear the minefield and destroy the Comm Sat.
segment.target: 避開巡邏艦火力，在遭重創前迅速脫離戰場。

segment.source: Imperial Corvettes are deploying mines around a Communication Satellite.
segment.target: 攻擊此通訊中心將迫使帝國調動艦隊前來增援。

segment.source: This diversion is needed to cover ship movements to the [[Greater Plooriod Cluster]]. The ruler there, [[Overlord Ghorin]], claims to have grown sympathetic to the Rebellion.$ This is significant because he controls several agricultural worlds. Our food supply will be secure if [[Ghorin]] joins the Alliance. We remain skeptical, though, because of [[Ghorin's]] reputation for heavy handed ruthlessness.
segment.target: 這場聲東擊西的佯攻旨在掩護前往[[大普魯里奧星團]]的艦船動向。當地的統治者[[格霍林霸主]]宣稱對反抗軍抱持同情。$ 這極具戰略意義，因其掌控著數個農業星球。若[[格霍林]]加入同盟，我們的糧荒將徹底解除。但鑑於格霍林殘暴兇狠的名聲，我們依然保持高度懷疑。

segment.source: Imperial forces are searching through thousands of remote systems to find us. Even so, the Empire can't be everywhere at once. Currently, they are attempting to improve their monitoring ability by enlarging their communications network.$ A new listening station is being constructed near [[Saheelindeel]]. This is far from any Alliance outposts and so will be attacked to divert Imperial attention.
segment.target: 帝國大軍正在成千上萬個偏遠星系中搜捕我們。即使如此，帝國也絕不可能兼顧銀河所有角落。目前他們正企圖藉由擴建通訊網絡提升監控能力。$ 一處全新的監聽站正在[[薩希林迪爾（Saheelindeel）]]附近興建。此處遠離同盟任何哨站，對其發動突襲是轉移帝國注意力的絕佳誘餌。

segment.source: Concentrate on the mines and satellite. Don't forget about your six torpedoes. That could eliminate six mines on your way in. Watch your shields. Retreat and power up as necessary, there is no time limit on this mission. Evade CRVs as much as possible.$ You will be attacked by 3 three ship GUN groups. Kill GUNs as you wish.$
segment.target: 集中全力打擊水雷與衛星。善用你的 6 枚質子魚雷，進場途中即可摧毀 6 顆水雷。隨時注意護盾能量，必要時後撤充能，本任務無時間限制。盡量規避巡邏艦火力。$ 你將遭遇 3 組各 3 架突擊砲艇（GUN）的圍攻，伺機殲滅之。$

segment.source: Be prepared to intercept any Imperial attacks.
segment.target: 隨時準備攔截任何可能出現的帝國突襲。

segment.target: [[格霍林的]]貨船將在此處將糧食轉運給我方貨船。

segment.source: With the clearing of the minefield we may proceed with the delivery of grain from [[Overlord Ghorin]]. Three of his Freighters are en route to meet three of ours.$ Two A-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will be sent ahead to maintain security at the rendezvous point. This supply of grain will be enough to restore our stockpile and allow us to get back to our main purpose...$overthrowing the Empire!
segment.target: 隨著水雷陣的肅清，我們得以展開自[[格霍林霸主]]處接收糧食的作業。他的三艘貨船正前來與我方三艘貨船會合。$ 來自[[紅隊]]的兩架 A翼戰機將提前部署，負責維持會合點的安全。這批糧食足以重建我們的戰略儲備，讓我們能重回最核心的使命……$推翻邪惡帝國！

segment.source: Be extremely alert, [[Overlord Ghorin]] is known to be ruthless and cunning. He may attempt to doublecross us and this could be a trap! If this works out, though, we will have found a great new ally.$ The Freighters for both sides will arrive singly about [[five]] minutes apart. The first two will be arriving almost immediately after you do. The cargo transfer process will take [[two]] minutes for each pair of Freighters.
segment.target: 務必保持最高警戒，[[格霍林霸主]]以冷酷狡詐著稱，他極可能背信棄義，這甚至可能是一場陷阱！然而若能成真，我們便贏得了一位強大的盟友。$ 雙方貨船將單獨進場，彼此間隔約[[五]]分鐘。前兩艘船將在你們抵達後立刻進場。每對貨船的轉運作業需耗時[[兩]]分鐘。

segment.source: You will be attacked by several waves of GUNs and TRNs. Watch for the TRNs especially because they launch torpedoes. segment.source: Fly a reconnaissance mission in your A-wing to verify the location of an Imperial grain storage facility.

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] is to confirm the reports of [[grain]] located at an Imperial depot.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]負責前往確認帝國倉庫藏有[[糧食]]的傳言。

segment.source: If true the Freighter[[ Sarsuma ]]will come out of hyperspace to take it.

segment.source: If there are enemy patrol craft in the area destroy them first!
segment.target: 若該空域存在敵軍巡邏艦艇，第一時間消滅之！

segment.source: [[Ghorin]] has doublecrossed us! The grain he sold us was very subtly tainted and would have sickened us all. Fortunately, we rigorously tested it before distribution. Without a new supply source we're worse off than before in our need for food.$ A small, lightly guarded Imperial storage area is rumored to have Cargo Containers full of grain. If this is confirmed an Alliance Freighter will be sent to seize the grain.
segment.target: [[格霍林]]背信棄義出賣了我們！他賣給我們的糧食被下了極其隱蔽的劇毒，差點毒害我們所有人。所幸我們在分發前實施了嚴格檢測。由於缺乏新糧源，我們的處境比以往任何時候都要絕望。$ 謠傳一處守備薄弱的帝國小型倉庫儲存了裝滿糧食的貨櫃。一旦查證屬實，同盟將派遣貨船強行奪糧。

segment.target: 你將駕駛 A翼戰機前往該處，對帝國倉庫實施武裝偵察。消滅遭遇的任何巡邏警衛。$ 隨後查驗是否有貨櫃裝有糧食。若確認有糧，貨船[[薩蘇瑪號]]將抵達回收物資。$ 隨時準備擊退任何帝國反擊，儘管該空域僻靜，預計不會有大部隊前來。

糧食貨櫃位置已鎖定並通報統帥部！
偵察任務圓滿達成，立即返回基地！

segment.source: As part of a master plan to seek revenge on Ghorin for his treachery against the Alliance, steal a group of his Y-wings.
segment.target: 以離子砲癱瘓格霍林的 護航 Y翼戰機與巡邏艦， 實施俘獲並沒收帝國軍款。

segment.source: The first part of the plan requires that we capture a number of [[Ghorin's]] Y-wings. These escorts, therefore, are the target.$ [[Red One]] will lead the raid with two Y-wings. As you disable the enemy ships, our Commando units will arrive to capture them. The Alliance Cruiser [[Maria]] will arrive in less than [[seven]] minutes to receive the captured ships.
segment.target: 復仇計畫的第一階段，要求我們必須俘獲一批[[格霍林]]手下的 Y翼戰機。因此，這些護航戰機正是核心獵物。$ [[紅一號]]將率領兩架 Y翼戰機發起突襲。每當你以離子砲癱瘓一架敵機，我方特擊小組便會進場俘獲。同盟巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號（Maria）]]將在不到[[七]]分鐘內跳入戰場接收被俘戰機。

segment.target: Y翼[[紅隊]]將在此超空間中繼點附近伏擊就位。

segment.source: [[Ghorin's]] Corvette [[Halifax]] will arrive with six escorting Y-wings.
segment.target: [[格霍林的]]巡邏艦[[哈利法克斯號（Halifax）]]將在六架 Y翼護航下抵達。

segment.source: Disable as many of [[Ghorin's]] Y-wings as you can so they may be captured.
segment.target: 盡可能以離子砲癱瘓[[格霍林的]] Y翼戰機，以便實施登艦俘虜。

segment.source: The [[Halifax]] will be disabled so that its cargo may be confiscated.
segment.target: 將[[哈利法克斯號]]以離子砲癱瘓，沒收沒收艦上的帝國巨款。

segment.source: The Alliance Cruiser [[Maria]] will enter to receive the captured Y-wings.
segment.target: 同盟巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]將進場接收所有受俘的 Y翼戰機。

segment.source: Alliance High Command has devised a plan to avenge [[Overlord Ghorin's]] doublecross. We will execute a series of operations to convince the Empire that it is the [[Emperor]] who is being doublecrossed, not us!$ As we were receiving the tainted grain a regular shipment to the Empire had been arranged, also. The payment for this is being brought back on the Corvette [[Halifax]]. [[Ghorin]] has sent six Y-wings as escort.$
segment.target: 同盟最高統帥部已策劃了一套精妙的復仇方案，誓要讓[[格霍林霸主]]為其背叛付出代價。我們將發動一系列精確作戰，讓帝國確信是格霍林在暗中背叛了[[皇帝]]，而不是我們！$ 在我們接收有毒糧食的同時，格霍林亦向帝國交付了一批正常口糧。帝國支付的巨額軍款正由巡邏艦[[哈利法克斯號]]運回，格霍林派出了六架 Y翼貼身護航。$

segment.source: Commandos will come in to capture the Y-wings and board the [[Halifax]].
segment.target: 特戰突擊隊將躍入戰場俘虜 Y翼戰機，並強行登上[[哈利法克斯號]]。

segment.source: After the cargo has been seized [[Red One]] will destroy the Corvette.
segment.target: 在沒收沒收全部軍款後，[[紅一號]]必須徹底擊沉該巡邏艦。

segment.source: As a bonus we will confiscate the Empire's payment to [[Ghorin]]. This will serve as an appropriate "refund" for the bad grain sold to us. The [[Halifax]] can not be crewed at this time and so will be destroyed.$ Move quickly as we wish to avoid detection by Imperial forces. Watch over the recovery operation and then follow the [[Maria]] out.$ Remember that Y-wings can survive a single torpedo so use them!
segment.target: 作為額外戰果，我們將沒收帝國支付給[[格霍林]]的整筆巨款，作為有毒糧食的合理「退款」。由於缺乏人手操控，[[哈利法克斯號]]必須予以摧毀。$ 行動必須神速以防被帝國主力察覺。完成俘獲回收後，跟隨[[瑪麗亞號]]跳出超空間撤離。$切記 Y翼戰機能承受單枚魚雷轟擊，放心開火！

segment.source: We will keep up our attacks on the Empire's food supplies. This time the target is a supply storage area in the [[Hollan D1]] sector. segment.target: 我們將持續打擊帝國的糧食供應。這次的目標是[[霍蘭 D1（Hollan D1）]]星區的物資儲備區。這座關鍵補給庫供應著整個星區。$ 我們將使用從[[格霍林（Ghorin）]]那裡俘獲的Y翼戰機。我們的計畫是要讓帝國相信[[格霍林]]在背叛他們。此外，這次攻擊將使該星區的帝國軍隊和我們一樣陷入缺糧危機！

segment.source: An Imperial Storage Area in the [[Hollan D1]] sector must be eliminated.

segment.target: 必須摧毀所有帝國糧食[[ ]]貨櫃。

segment.target: 必須摧毀所有貨櫃（CON）與貨船（FRT）。任務開始數秒後就有兩艘貨船準備脫離。請迅速逼近，並命令僚機攻擊領頭貨船。你自己對其發射兩枚魚雷。$ 你將遭到 4 架太空梭（SHU）及隨後 4 架進階型鈦戰機（T/A）的攻擊。擊毀太空梭並規避進階型鈦戰機。突擊砲艇（GUN）隨後也會進場攻擊你。第 3 艘貨船將在任務進行到[[第 5]]分鐘時進入。將剩餘的六枚魚雷全用在它身上。

segment.source: Be sure not to let any Imperial Freighters escape from the area.

segment.target: 皇帝一定會認為格霍林背叛了他！

segment.source: Attack and destroy an Imperial convoy of Corvettes carrying an important grain shipment.
segment.target: 攻擊並摧毀一支載運 重要糧食物資的 帝國巡邏艦 護航船隊。

segment.source: We will continue to attack Imperial food supplies. This strike will be against a convoy of several Corvettes bound for the [[Geedon]] system.$ As part of our plan to discredit [[Overlord Ghorin]] we will use some of the Y-wings you helped capture. This should make it appear that he has betrayed the Emperor. It will also disrupt Imperial operations as they are forced to search for food.
segment.target: 我們將持續打擊帝國的糧食供應。這次突擊的目標是一支前往[[吉登（Geedon）]]星系的數艘巡邏艦船隊。$ 作為抹黑[[格霍林霸主]]計畫的一部分，我們將使用你們協助俘獲的部分Y翼戰機。這會使局勢看起來像是他背叛了皇帝。這也將迫使帝國四處搜括糧食，進一步打亂其軍事行動。

segment.source: Five captured Y-wings will be used to completely destroy this food convoy.
segment.target: 將使用五架俘獲的Y翼戰機徹底摧毀這支糧食船隊。

segment.source: A convoy of Imperial Corvettes is headed for the [[Geedon]] system.
segment.target: 一支帝國巡邏艦船隊正前往[[吉登（Geedon）]]星系。

segment.source: [[Red ]]Squadron will provide two X-wings to escort the attacking Y-wings.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣兩架X翼戰機護航發動攻擊的Y翼戰機。

segment.source: You and your wingman will escort the captured Y-wings. Use your torpedoes to assist, but be prepared to break off and intercept any Imperial reinforcements.
segment.target: 你與你的僚機將護航俘獲的Y翼戰機。使用質子魚雷協助攻擊，但隨時準備脫離以攔截任何帝國增援。

segment.source: Don't worry about the Y-Ws too much, and save your torps for any CRVs that are left after all the Y-Ws are destroyed. You will have to finish off any remaining CRVs.$ Remember CRVs have a blind spot. The safest way to approach a CRV is dead level from the rear. Their engine exhausts should appear perfectly square as you close in. Note which lasers are firing at you, top or bottom, and adjust.
segment.target: 不必過度擔心Y翼戰機，保留你的魚雷對付在所有Y翼被摧毀後倖存的巡邏艦（CRV）。你必須親自解決所有殘存的巡邏艦。$ 記住巡邏艦有防禦死角。接近巡邏艦最安全的方式是從正後方處於完全水平的位置逼近。當你逼近時，它們的引擎噴口應該呈現完美的正方形。注意是上方還是下方的雷射在朝你射擊，並及時調整機動。

segment.source: The Imperial Convoy has been destroyed
THE EMPIRE SHOULD SOON FEEL THE LOSS OF ITS FOOD SUPPLIES
segment.target: 帝國很快就會體會到失去糧食供應的痛苦

segment.source: THE EMPEROR WILL BE CONVINCED OF GHORIN'S TREACHERY NOW
segment.target: 皇帝現在深信格霍林叛變了

segment.source: Fly a Y-wing to ambush an Imperial grain convoy and swap cargoes with our Freighters.
segment.target: 駕駛Y翼戰機伏擊 帝國糧食船隊， 並與我方貨船 掉換貨物。
>第 13 號作戰：糧食調包行動

segment.source: Y-wing groups [[Red]] and[[ Gold]] will ambush the grain convoy here.
segment.target: Y翼編隊[[紅隊]]與[[金隊]]將在此伏擊糧食船隊。

segment.source: The convoy consists of two Freighters and several smaller vessels.
segment.target: 該船隊由兩艘貨船與數艘小型艦艇組成。

segment.source: [[Gold]] will disable the Freighters while [[Red]] disables the rest of the ships.
segment.target: [[金隊]]將癱瘓貨船，而[[紅隊]]則癱瘓其餘艦船。

segment.source: Our Commandos will then come in to board them and replace the crews.
segment.target: 我方特戰突擊隊隨後將進場強行登艦並替換船員。

segment.source: As the Freighters are disabled ours will come in to exchange cargos.
segment.target: 當敵方貨船被癱瘓後，我方貨船將進場調換貨物。

segment.source: All our vessels must evacuate the area before Imperial ships arrive.
segment.target: 我方所有艦船必須在帝國艦隊抵達前撤離該區域。

segment.source: This operation is the final step in our plan to discredit [[Ghorin]]. This grain convoy is en route to an Imperial base. We will stop it and substitute crews and cargo.$ All vessels in the convoy must be disabled as quickly as possible. Their ships will then be boarded and their crews replaced. The grain will be exchanged with the poisoned grain we were sold. We will then evacuate before Imperial forces can respond.
segment.target: 本次作戰是我們抹黑[[格霍林]]計畫的最終階段。這支糧食船隊正前往一座帝國基地。我們將攔截它，並替換船員與貨物。$ 船隊中的所有艦船都必須儘快被癱瘓。隨後我們將登艦並替換船員。糧食將調換為當初賣給我們的那批毒糧食。接著我們將在帝國部隊來得及反應前迅速撤離。

segment.source: The replacement crews will claim to have driven off the "pirate" attack. It is absolutely essential that no Alliance ships be detected by Imperial forces.$ Destroy any escorting fighters as quickly as you can.$ Time is critical, so fire a few torpedoes into each of the Freighters to assist Y-wing [[Gold ]]as they disable them.$
segment.target: 替換後的船員將宣稱擊退了『海盜』的襲擊。帝國部隊絕對不能察覺任何同盟艦船的蹤跡，這一點至關重要。$ 儘快消滅所有護航戰機。$ 時間緊迫，因此向每艘貨船發射幾枚魚雷，協助Y翼[[金隊]]將其癱瘓。$

segment.source: [[Red One]] will be responsible for eliminating the Y-wing escorts.
segment.target: [[紅隊長]]將負責消滅敵方的Y翼護航機。

segment.source: If the enemy FRTs are escaping try putting a few torpedoes in them to aid Y-W [[Gold]]. Do this as early as you can.$ You may find yourself having to disable almost everything, (including the FRTs) as your wingman are not very effective.$ The Imperials will arrive [[13]] minutes after mission start. The Rebel FRTs must have completed docking before this to escape in time.
segment.target: 如果敵方貨船（FRT）試圖逃跑，嘗試發射幾枚魚雷協助Y翼[[金隊]]。儘早執行。$ 你可能會發現自己必須幾乎癱瘓所有目標（包括貨船），因為你的僚機效率不高。$ 帝國軍將在任務開始後[[第 13]]分鐘抵達。反抗軍貨船必須在此之前完成對接，才能及時逃脫。

segment.source: GREAT WORK, GHORIN'S HAD IT NOW!
segment.target: 幹得漂亮，格霍林這下完蛋了！
掉包調換作業已全數完成

segment.source: THE IMPERIALS WILL BE TOLD WE WERE SCARED AWAY
segment.target: 帝國軍將會被告知我們被嚇退逃跑了

segment.source: Confirm delivery to the Empire of the grain shipment that has been poisoned by Ghorin.
segment.target: 確認格霍林 所提供的毒糧食 已成功交付 給帝國軍。
>第 14 號作戰：確認糧食交付

segment.source: Do not engage the Transports! Defend yourself only if attacked.
segment.target: 切勿與運輸艦交火！僅在遭受攻擊時進行自衛。

segment.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Elite]] is expecting its food supplies to arrive shortly.
segment.target: 帝國巡防艦[[菁英號（Elite）]]預計物資補給將在短時間內抵達。

segment.source: The [[Elite's]] starfighters are reported to include the new TIE Advanced.
segment.target: 據報[[菁英號]]配屬的星際戰機編隊包含新型的進階型鈦戰機。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] must ID each TRN until a cargo of tainted grain is confirmed.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]必須辨識每一艘運輸艦，直到確認載有變質糧食的貨物為止。

segment.source: You will need to stay close to the [[Elite]] so no supply ships can slip by.
segment.target: 你必須緊貼在[[菁英號]]附近，以免任何補給艦悄悄溜過。

segment.source: The grain exchange operation was successful. Now [[High Command]] wants to confirm that the tainted grain is being distributed to Imperial forces. A Nebulon B stationed in the [[Droma]] sector is waiting for a supply shipment. [[ Red]] Squadron will send three A-wings to identify any Transports entering that area. All that is needed is to confirm delivery of the tainted grain.$ Do not engage the Transports!
segment.target: 糧食掉包作戰圓滿成功。現在[[最高統帥部]]希望確認這批毒糧食確實已分發至帝國部隊手中。一艘駐紮在[[德羅馬（Droma）]]星區的尼布隆B級護衛巡防艦正等待補給船隊。[[紅隊]]中隊將派遣三架A翼戰機去辨識進入該區域的任何運輸艦。你唯一需要做的就是確認毒糧食的送達。$ 切勿攻擊運輸艦！

segment.source: This Frigate, the [[Elite]], is reported to have the new Advanced TIE Fighter among its starfighter complement. Defend yourself if attacked but concentrate on identifying the Transports as they arrive.
segment.target: 據報這艘巡防艦[[菁英號]]的星際戰機編隊中配備有新型進階型鈦戰機。若遭受攻擊可進行自衛，但務必專注於辨識抵達的運輸艦。

segment.source: There is only one TRN carrying grain. It is number 2 in a 3 ship group that enters [[6:18]] minutes after mission start. All enemy fighters increase in skill level with each new wave of each type.$ Beware of the T/As, the first one is a Novice and may collide with you. Use your wingmen to gang up on a single T/A at a time. (Their shields regenerate quickly.) Use missiles on T/Bs; don't waste them on T/As.
segment.target: 只有一艘運輸艦載運糧食。它是任務開始後[[第 6 分 18 秒]]進入的三艦編組中的第 2 艘。所有敵方戰機的技術等級都會隨著每一波增援而提升。$ 小心進階型鈦戰機（T/A），第一批是新手，可能會撞上你。命令你的僚機每次集中火力對付單一架進階型鈦戰機（它們的護盾恢復很快）。用飛彈對付鈦式轟炸機（T/B），別浪費在進階型鈦戰機上。

segment.source: YOU HAVE CONFIRMED THE DISTRIBUTION OF THE TAINTED GRAIN
segment.target: 你已確認毒糧食已完成分發

segment.source: IMPERIAL FORCES SHOULD SOON SUFFER THE ILL EFFECTS
segment.target: 帝國軍隊很快就會嚐到其惡果

segment.source: THANKS, RED ONE, THAT WAS SOME GREAT FIGHTING!
segment.target: 謝謝你，紅隊長，打得太精彩了！

segment.source: Attack Imperial research and development site and capture the TIE Advanced spacecraft that are being built there.
segment.target: 攻擊帝國研發基地， 並俘獲正在該處 建造的進階型鈦戰機 太空星艦。
>第 15 號作戰：奪取進階型鈦戰機

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will lead the raid. [[Red One]] will be responsible for clearing the minefield. The others will take out the arriving Shuttle and the upper level of the facility.$ The mission has been planned to take advantage of a crew shift change. Nevertheless, be prepared to face stiff opposition. This is a very valuable asset to the Empire and they can be counted on to respond quickly!
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將帶頭突襲。[[紅隊長]]將負責清理雷區。其餘戰機將摧毀抵達的太空梭以及基地的上層建築。$ 本次任務經過縝密策劃，選在值班人員換班時發動。然而，仍需做好面對頑強抵抗的準備。這是帝國極為寶貴的資產，可以預見他們會迅速做出反擊！

segment.source: [[Advanced TIE Fighters]] are being tested at a secret location.
segment.target: [[進階型鈦戰機]]正在一處機密地點進行測試。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] must intercept the Shuttle arriving with the new pilots.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]必須攔截載運新飛行員抵達的太空梭。

segment.source: Our attack has been timed to hit during a routine staff rotation.
segment.target: 我方的攻擊時間點特別選在例行人員換班輪替期間。

segment.source: Then clear the minefield and destroy the upper Containers of the facility.
segment.target: 接著清除雷區並摧毀該設施的上層貨櫃。

segment.source: The facility is surrounded by a protective layer of mines.
segment.target: 該設施周圍佈設了防禦性的雷區保護層。

segment.source: Freighter [[Ashanti]] will then arrive to dock with one of the Fighter sheds.
segment.target: 貨船[[阿散蒂號（Ashanti）]]隨後將抵達並與其中一座戰機機棚對接。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will patrol the area while the operation proceeds.
segment.target: 在行動進行期間，A翼[[紅隊]]將在該區域執行警戒巡邏。

segment.source: Alliance Intelligence has discovered a secret Imperial base where the new [[TIE Advanced]] is being tested and new pilots trained. This new starfighter was first observed during the [[Battle of Yavin]]. More recently it was observed during an armed reconnaissance in the [[Droma ]]Sector. Not only is it faster than our A-wing, it has shields as well! We must acquire examples of this fighter so that we may study it.
segment.target: 同盟情報部發現了一座秘密帝國基地，新型[[進階型鈦戰機]]正在那裡進行測試並培訓新飛行員。這款新型戰機最早是在[[雅汶戰役]]中被目擊。最近則是在[[德羅馬（Droma）]]星區的武裝偵察中再度現身。它不僅比我們的A翼更快，而且還配備有護盾！我們必須奪取這種戰機的實機樣品，以便進行研究。

segment.source: Your wingmen will take out the SHU and upper CONs. Only two T/As are active and dangerous. The others are stationary with their shields down.$ Respond quickly to the incoming GUNs, but save at least 8 missiles for the pair of CRVs and TRN that come in later. Use your remaining missiles on one CRV. Then take out the TRN ASAP (order your wingmen to help.) Finish off the weakened CRV then blindside the other.
segment.target: 你的僚機將摧毀太空梭（SHU）與上層貨櫃（CON）。只有兩架進階型鈦戰機（T/A）處於啟動並具威脅性狀態。其餘的戰機停放未啟動且護盾關閉。$ 對進場的突擊砲艇（GUN）迅速做出反應，但務必保留至少 8 枚飛彈給稍後進場的兩艘巡邏艦（CRV）與運輸艦（TRN）。將剩餘飛彈集中在其中一艘巡邏艦上。接著儘快摧毀運輸艦（命令僚機協助）。擊沉受損的巡邏艦，然後從死角偷襲另一艘。

segment.source: WE'LL DELIVER THESE ADVANCED TIES TO OUR SCIENTISTS FOR STUDY
segment.target: 我們將把這些進階型鈦戰機送交科學家進行研究

segment.source: Protect Alliance convoy of Freighters and Corvettes as they try to avoid destruction by Imperial forces.
segment.target: 保護由貨船與 巡邏艦組成的同盟船團， 協助他們躲過 帝國軍隊的毀滅打擊。
>第 16A 號作戰：護送船團前往跳躍點

segment.source: Two A-wings from [[Red]] Squadron will patrol the area between the two Nav Buoys. Stay alert and be prepared to ward off any Imperial attacks.$ The three groups are [[five]] minutes apart. Each will take about [[thirteen]] minutes to reach the next jump point.$ All of these ships carry critical supplies so we can't afford to lose even one of them.
segment.target: [[紅隊]]中隊的兩架A翼戰機將在兩座導航浮標之間巡邏。保持高度戒備，隨時準備擊退帝國的任何攻擊。$ 三個編組之間相隔[[五]]分鐘。每個編組大約需要[[十三]]分鐘才能到達下一個超空間跳躍點。$ 所有這些艦船都載運著關鍵物資，我們承擔不起失去任何一艘的代價。

segment.source: An Alliance convoy of Freighters and Corvettes will arrive in three groups.
segment.target: 由貨船與巡邏艦組成的同盟船團將分三組抵達。

segment.source: First attack is by 4 GUNs with 2 following waves. The FRG arrives 7:18 into the mission. It launches one sqdn of T/Bs and one sqdn of T/Is. (Two groups of two ships each for both types with 3 following waves.)$ Destroy all GUNs as quickly as you can. The FRG arrives about 20 klicks away so finish off the GUNs and then go after the T/Bs. Evade the T/Is until all T/Bs are gone.
segment.target: 第一波攻擊由 4 架突擊砲艇（GUN）發起，後續有 2 波增援。巡防艦將在任務進行到 7:18 時抵達，並放出一個中隊的鈦式轟炸機（T/B）與一個中隊的鈦式截擊機（T/I）。（兩種機型各為兩組、每組兩架，後續有 3 波增援。）$ 儘快摧毀所有突擊砲艇。巡防艦出現在約 20 公里外，因此先解決突擊砲艇，然後追擊鈦式轟炸機。在所有鈦式轟炸機被消滅前，先規避鈦式截擊機。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will patrol at this hyperspace transfer point.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將在此超空間中轉點執行巡邏。

segment.source: Each group will consist of a Freighter and two Corvettes.
segment.target: 每個編組由一艘貨船與兩艘巡邏艦組成。

segment.source: The convoy is critical as it has all the supplies to establish a new base.
segment.target: 這支船團極為關鍵，載有建立新基地所需的一切物資。

segment.source: The Alliance continues to search for a good location to rebuild our secret base. This convoy of Freighters and Corvettes carry vital supplies and personnel from the base we abandoned on [[Yavin]].$ This is everything we need to establish a new base as soon as a suitable location can be found. In the meantime we continue to evade the Empire in a deadly game of hide and seek.
segment.target: 同盟正持續尋找重建秘密基地的理想地點。這支由貨船與巡邏艦組成的船團載運著我們從[[雅汶]]撤離的關鍵物資與人員。$ 只要找到合適的地點，這些就是我們建立新基地所需的一切。在此期間，我們將繼續與帝國玩這場致命的捉迷藏遊戲。

segment.source: WELL DONE, RED TWO. THE CONVOY IS SAFE
segment.target: 幹得好，紅二號。船團已安全

segment.source: HEAD HOME FOR YOUR NEXT ASSIGNMENT
segment.target: 返航基地準備執行下一項任務

segment.source: Protect neutral supply convoy in an attempt to win their support for the Rebel Alliance.
segment.target: 保護中立物資船團， 爭取他們對 反抗軍同盟的 全力支持。
>第 16B 號作戰：支援潛在盟友

segment.source: The [[Leafar]] are ready to join the Alliance and want our protection.
segment.target: [[李法爾人（Leafar）]]已準備加入同盟並尋求我方保護。

segment.source: Patrol this busy hyperspace transit area and intercept any threat.
segment.target: 巡邏這片繁忙的超空間交通區，並攔截任何威脅。

segment.source: Proof is needed of our ability to offer protection to members of the Alliance. The [[Leafar]] have begun to challenge the Empire and are certain to face retribution. Alliance forces are therefore being sent to protect an important transfer point near their system.$ If we can protect their shipping from Imperial attack we will have gained a new ally.
segment.target: 我們必須證明有能力保護同盟的成員。[[李法爾人]]已開始對抗帝國，勢必會面臨報復。因此同盟部隊被派往保護靠近他們星系的重要中轉點。$ 如果我們能保護他們的商船免受帝國攻擊，我們就將贏得一位新盟友。

segment.source: Order your wingmen to attack the T/As while you concentrate on the T/Bs. Don't let any Bombers sneak past you.$ Ignore any T/As that attack you until all Bombers are destroyed.$ As soon as 3 CRVs, 2 FRTs and 4 SHUs make it into hyperspace you will get the mission complete message.
segment.target: 命令僚機攻擊進階型鈦戰機（T/A），而你集中精力對付鈦式轟炸機（T/B）。絕不能讓任何轟炸機溜過去。$ 在所有轟炸機被消滅前，先忽略攻擊你的進階型鈦戰機。$ 只要有 3 艘巡邏艦（CRV）、2 艘貨船（FRT）和 4 架太空梭（SHU）進入超空間，你就會收到任務完成的訊息。

segment.source: There will be a series of Freighters, Corvettes and Shuttles.
segment.target: 現場將有一連串的貨船、巡邏艦與太空梭。

segment.source: The Task Force led by CRS [[Maria]] will respond to any large scale attack.
segment.target: 由巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號（Maria）]]率領的特遣艦隊將應對任何大規模攻擊。

segment.source: Hold out until relieved. A-W [[Gold]] is also near and may come to your aid.
segment.target: 堅守直到接應部隊抵達。A翼[[金隊]]也就在附近，可能會前來支援。

segment.source: You will lead a five ship group of X-wings from[[ Red]] Squadron. Stay near the transfer point and be prepared to intercept any Imperial threat.$ An Alliance Task Force led by the Cruiser [[Maria]] and the Frigate [[Whitehawk]] is in this sector and will reinforce in case of a large scale attack by the Empire.$ You must ensure that as many merchant ships as possible survive.
segment.target: 你將率領[[紅隊]]中隊的五架X翼戰機編組。留在中轉點附近，隨時準備攔截任何帝國威脅。$ 由巡洋艦[[瑪麗亞號]]與巡防艦[[白鷹號（Whitehawk）]]率領的同盟特遣艦隊正在本星區，一旦帝國發動大規模攻擊將前來增援。$ 你必須確保盡可能多的商船倖存下來。

segment.source: WELL DONE, RED ONE, WE'LL TAKE OVER FROM HERE
segment.target: 幹得漂亮，紅隊長，接下來交給我們

segment.source: Escort Alliance Corvettes in their attack and destroy mission against the Imperial Frigate Red Wind.
segment.target: 護航同盟巡邏艦 執行針對帝國 紅風號巡防艦的 攻擊與摧毀任務。
>第 17 號作戰：攻擊紅風號巡防艦

segment.source: Alliance Corvettes will conduct a revenge run against this Frigate.
segment.target: 同盟巡邏艦將對這艘巡防艦發起復仇突擊。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red]] will fly point in this attack to clear the mines and any fighters.
segment.target: A翼[[紅隊]]將在此次攻擊中擔任前鋒，清理雷區與敵方戰機。

segment.source: The assault run will be made in three waves of three Corvettes.
segment.target: 突擊行動將由三波、每波三艘巡邏艦發起衝鋒。

segment.source: The infamous Imperial Frigate [[Red Wind]] has been located near [[Plooriod IV]]. A small minefield has been placed around it suggesting it is immobile and may be undergoing repairs.$ The [[Red Wind's]] commander is one of the most ruthless and has been involved in numerous atrocities. Several Corvette crews have demanded we make this revenge attack.
segment.target: 惡名昭彰的帝國巡防艦[[紅風號]]在[[普魯里奧四號（Plooriod IV）]]附近被發現。其周圍佈設了小型雷區，顯示它目前動彈不得且可能正在進行搶修。$ [[紅風號]]的指揮官是帝國最殘暴的軍官之一，曾犯下無數暴行。多名巡邏艦船員強烈要求發動這次復仇襲擊。

segment.source: The Imperial Frigate [[Red Wind ]]has been identified near [[Plooriod IV]].
segment.target: 帝國巡防艦[[紅風號]]已在[[普魯里奧四號]]附近被確認。

segment.source: It appears to be undergoing repairs and has a small minefield around it.
segment.target: 該艦似乎正在維修中，周圍佈有小型雷區。

segment.source: The strike force will consist of nine Corvettes. They will attack in three waves of three ships each.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send two A-wings ahead of the first wave to clear the minefield and intercept any Imperial starfighters. You will remain in the area throughout the entire assault.
segment.target: 突擊部隊由九艘巡邏艦組成。它們將分成三波、每波三艘發起攻擊。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將在第一波之前派出兩架A翼清除雷區並攔截任何帝國戰機。你將在整個突擊過程中留在戰區。

segment.source: Do not shoot the container. Ignore the two FRTs, TRN and SHU. Primary concerns are the T/Bs and their torpedos. Use your wingman wisely.$ Once the CRVs get close to the FRG, take out the mines. You may have to do a little damage to the FRG yourself. Hit it with lasers when in range waiting for the next wave to launch. You may try firing all twelve missiles at the [[Red Wind]] during the first wave.
segment.target: 切勿射擊貨櫃。忽略兩艘貨船（FRT）、運輸艦（TRN）和太空梭（SHU）。最首要的威脅是鈦式轟炸機（T/B）及其魚雷。善用你的僚機。$ 一旦巡邏艦逼近巡防艦，立刻摧毀水雷。你可能需要親自對巡防艦造成一些傷害。在等待下一波發射時，進入射程內就用雷射射擊它。你也可以在第一波期間嘗試向[[紅風號]]發射所有十二枚飛彈。
這肯定能大大提振同盟士氣！

segment.source: Capture Imperial Assault Gunboats in preparation for attacking secret research site.
segment.target: 俘獲帝國 突擊砲艇， 為攻擊機密 研發基地做準備。
>第 18 號作戰：俘獲帝國砲艇

segment.source: Y-wing[[ Red]] will lead the raid. First, eliminate all Imperial defenses.
segment.target: Y翼[[紅隊]]將帶頭突襲。首先消滅所有帝國防禦。

segment.source: Then locate and disable any Gunboats in the area.
segment.target: 然後搜尋並癱瘓該區域內的所有突擊砲艇。

segment.source: Shuttle group [[Leary]] will deliver the Commando teams to the Gunboats.
segment.target: 太空梭編組[[利里隊（Leary）]]將載運特戰突擊隊登上砲艇。

segment.source: After the Gunboats are captured the Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will arrive.
segment.target: 突擊砲艇被俘獲後，巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號（Cathleen）]]將抵達。

segment.source: After the Gunboats are recovered you can finish off the outpost.
segment.target: 回收砲艇後，你即可徹底摧毀前哨基地。

segment.source: We only need three Gunboats, and there are usually at least this many on station at these bases. In addition, there are typically at least two or three Corvettes defending the base.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send two Y-wings in to eliminate the base's defenses and disable the Gunboats. Shuttles will deliver capture teams and the Cruiser [[Cathleen]] will recover them.
segment.target: 我們只需要三艘砲艇，而這些基地通常至少有這麼多砲艇駐防。此外，通常至少有兩到三艘巡邏艦防衛基地。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣兩架Y翼消滅基地防禦並癱瘓砲艇。太空梭將運送俘獲小組，巡洋艦[[凱瑟琳號]]負責回收俘獲的船隻。

segment.source: Analysis of the Advanced TIE Fighters we captured proves that the Empire has developed a new shield technology. Information received from the [[Leafar]] suggest this technology is being developed further for larger vessels.$ A Corellian Corvette is reportedly next to be equipped with this new technology. The development site is "hidden in plain sight" at a Force Escort system outpost.
segment.target: 對我們俘獲的進階型鈦戰機進行分析後證實，帝國已經開發出新型護盾技術。從[[李法爾人（Leafar）]]處獲得的情報顯示，該技術正在進一步推廣至更大型艦船。$ 據報一艘柯爾里亞巡邏艦接下來將裝備這種新技術。研發地點就『公然隱藏』在武裝護航星系前哨站中。

segment.source: These outposts serve as small bases for System Patrol Squadrons of Assault Gunboats and Corvettes.$ The plan to raid the development site will require the use of some captured Imperial Gunboats. These will be used in a Trojan Horse style gambit to get in close to the test Corvette. We intend to capture this ship intact for use in a major surprise attack Alliance Command is planning.
segment.target: 這些前哨站作為突擊砲艇與巡邏艦的星系巡邏中隊小型基地。$ 突襲研發基地的計畫需要使用幾艘俘獲的帝國砲艇。這些砲艇將用於特洛伊木馬式的計策，以接近測試中的巡邏艦。我們打算完整奪取這艘艦船，用於同盟司令部正在籌劃的一場重大奇襲。

segment.source: A System Patrol Squadron's base is to be raided to capture Gunboats.
segment.target: 突襲星系巡邏中隊基地以俘獲突擊砲艇。

segment.source: Do a circle while you charge up and cycle ships through the CMD. Fire six tropedoes at one CRV and two at another on your way in. Order wingman to help you attack same CRV. The third CRV now has a unprotected blind spot (dead level).$ Keep an eye on the T/Bs. Watch for the three Imperial SHUs that come in just after the Alliance SHUs. Do not attack the CONs until after the "MISSION COMPLETE" message.
segment.target: 在為護盾充能時繞圈飛行，並在戰鬥機動顯示器（CMD）中循環切換艦船目標。在進場途中向一艘巡邏艦（CRV）發射六枚魚雷，向另一艘發射兩枚。命令僚機協助你攻擊同一艘巡邏艦。第三艘巡邏艦現在會有一個無防禦的盲區（正後方水平位）。$ 隨時注意鈦式轟炸機（T/B）。注意在同盟太空梭之後進場的三架帝國太空梭（SHU）。在出現「任務完成」訊息前，切勿攻擊貨櫃（CON）。
我們已奪得帝國突擊砲艇
趁還來得及，趕快返航基地

segment.source: Attack secret research site and steal Corvette in which a new super shield technology is being installed.
segment.target: 突襲秘密研發基地， 奪取正在安裝 全新超級護盾技術的 巡邏艦。
>第 19 號作戰：俘獲 X 型巡邏艦

segment.source: This is the site where an Imperial Corvette is receiving new shields.
segment.target: 這座基地就是帝國巡邏艦接受新護盾改裝的地點。

segment.source: Y-wing [[Red One]] will lead a raid to capture this experimental ship.
segment.target: Y翼[[紅隊長]]將率領突襲行動俘獲這艘實驗艦。

segment.source: [[Red One]] must locate and disable the Corvette then protect the capture.
segment.target: [[紅隊長]]必須定位並癱瘓巡邏艦，隨後掩護俘獲作業。

segment.source: Once disabled, [[Storm Unit's]] Transport will deliver the capture team.
segment.target: 一旦癱瘓，[[風暴部隊]]的運輸艦將運送俘獲小組登艦。

segment.source: [[Red One]] will be escorted into the area by captured [[Assault]] [[Gunboats]].
segment.target: [[紅隊長]]將在俘獲的[[突擊]][[砲艇]]護航下進入該區域。

segment.source: Be prepared to clear mines and fight off Imperial reinforcements!
segment.target: 隨時準備清除水雷並擊退帝國的增援部隊！

segment.source: A heavier version of the Empire's new shield technology is being fitted to a Corellian Corvette. This prototype is to be captured just before it begins testing.$ The development test site has been made to appear to be an ordinary Patrol Squadron base. The Imperial Gunboats [[Red]] Squadron helped capture will now be used to escort Y-wing [[Red One]] into the base area.
segment.target: 帝國新型護盾技術的重型版本正在改裝至一艘柯爾里亞巡邏艦上。這艘原型艦將在測試開始前被我們截獲。$ 研發測試基地偽裝成一般的巡邏中隊基地。[[紅隊]]中隊協助俘獲的帝國突擊砲艇現在將用於護航Y翼[[紅隊長]]進入基地區域。

segment.source: The Gunboat crews will claim to be escorting a defecting Rebel pilot. This deception should allow [[Red One]] to get within two kilometers before they discover the ruse.$ [[Red One]] must locate and disable the prototype Corvette while eliminating any Imperial threat. Then you must protect the capture team when they arrive. Once captured, the Corvette will be sent on for final preparations.
segment.target: 突擊砲艇組員將宣稱護送一名叛逃的反抗軍飛行員。這計策應能讓[[紅隊長]]在被識破前接近到兩公里以內。$ [[紅隊長]]必須找到並癱瘓原型巡邏艦，同時清除任何帝國威脅。隨後在俘獲小組抵達時保護他們。一旦俘獲成功，巡邏艦將送往進行最終準備。

segment.source: The special CRV is the fifth one in the target list as you cycle forward in the CMD (its spatial position varies.) As you approach it order your escorts to wait at least 2 klicks away (out of gun range.)$ Use 6 torps at maximum range to destroy the CRV above the special CRV. Fire 2 torps into special CRV, then clear the mines. When enemy GUNs arrive, order your escorts to proceed with their mission.
segment.target: 這艘特殊的巡邏艦（CRV）是在 CMD 中往前切換時的第 5 艘目標（其空間位置會變動）。當你逼近時，命令護航戰機在至少 2 公里外待命（在艦砲射程之外）。$ 在最大射程下使用 6 枚魚雷摧毀特殊巡邏艦上方的那艘巡邏艦。對特殊巡邏艦發射 2 枚魚雷，然後清理水雷。當敵方砲艇（GUN）出現時，命令護航機繼續執行任務。

segment.source: WE HAVE CAPTURED THE EMPIRE'S NEW SHIELD TECHNOLOGY
segment.target: 我們已奪得帝國新型護盾技術
計畫正在按部就班實現

segment.source: Defend a newly captured Corvette as it is being out- fitted for its attack mission against an Imperial shipyard.
segment.target: 保衛新俘獲的巡邏艦， 該艦正在加裝改裝， 準備執行攻擊 帝國造船廠的 任務。
>第 20 號作戰：保衛公羊角號

segment.source: Congratulations on the capture of the Corvette [[Blade 5]]. This specially modified ship is the key element in Operation "[[Ram's Head]]."$ The plan was first proposed after the loss of the Freighter [[Sarsuma ]]during[[ ]]Operation "[[Grain Snatch]]." Analysis of the flight data suggested that perhaps a Freighter or other vessel could somehow be used to decapitate a Star Destroyer by ramming its bridge.
segment.target: 恭喜成功俘獲巡邏艦[[利刃5號（Blade 5）]]。這艘經過特殊改裝的艦船是「[[公羊角（Ram's Head）]]」作戰的關鍵核心。$ 該計畫是在「[[糧食爭奪戰（Grain Snatch）]]」作戰中失去貨船[[薩爾蘇馬號（Sarsuma）]]後首次提出的。分析飛行數據後顯示，或許能用貨船或其他艦船撞擊滅星者艦橋，直接斬首其指揮中樞。

segment.source: The [[Ram's Head]] must transfer personnel to prepare it for use.
segment.target: [[公羊角號]]必須進行人員轉移，以完成出擊準備。

segment.source: Our Corvette [[Libra]] is waiting for the captured ship [[Ram's Head]] to arrive.
segment.target: 我方巡邏艦[[天秤號（Libra）]]正等待俘獲的艦船[[公羊角號]]抵達。

segment.source: X-wing [[Red]] is to secure the area during the personnel transfer.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]將在人員轉移期間負責確保該區域安全。

segment.source: Before you go on this mission the entire [[Alliance High Command]] would like to take this opportunity to congratulate [[Red]] Squadron for your terrific successes so far. Special thanks are due [[Red One]]. Without your skills and dedication the Rebellion could not continue! Good luck, and may the force be with you.$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: 在你們出發前，全體[[同盟最高統帥部]]想藉此機會祝賀[[紅隊]]中隊迄今為止取得的輝煌戰果。特別要向[[紅隊長]]致謝。如果沒有你的超凡身手與奉獻精神，起義革命將難以為繼！祝你們好運，願原力與你們同在！$$>點選黑色頁碼框$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: The new shield technology used on [[Blade 5]] promises to make this idea feasible. The captured Corvette has been renamed "[[Ram's Head]]" in honor of the operation it is to be used in.$ Operation "[[Ram's Head]]" will strike an Imperial Deep Dock where several Star Destroyers are being repaired. The Interdictor Cruisers that normally protect the dock have been lured away by an Alliance trick.
segment.target: [[利刃5號]]上應用的新型護盾技術有望讓這個構想成為現實。俘獲的巡邏艦已被重新命名為「[[公羊角號]]」，以紀念即將執行的作戰。$ 「[[公羊角]]」作戰將打擊一座正在維修數艘滅星者的帝國深空船塢。平時保護船塢的阻絕者巡洋艦已被同盟的計策引開。

segment.source: This mission is similar to the 1st one of this tour only harder.$ Head toward the FRG as soon as it appears. T/Bs are the main threat again and you have to be quick.$ You will be attacked by T/As instead of T/Fs but you should evade them the same way.$ A CRV arrives at [[9:00]] minutes into the mission and a couple of TRNs arrive at [[10:30]], so save some torpedoes!
segment.target: 本次任務與本戰役第 1 關類似，但難度更高。$ 巡防艦一出現就立刻朝它飛去。鈦式轟炸機（T/B）依舊是主要威脅，你必須迅速行動。$ 攻擊你的將是進階型鈦戰機（T/A）而不是普通鈦戰機（T/F），但規避方式相同。$ 一艘巡邏艦（CRV）在任務進行至[[9:00]]時抵達，幾艘運輸艦（TRN）在[[10:30]]抵達，務必保留一些魚雷！

segment.source: Our finest technicians are waiting aboard the Corvette [[Libra]]. They have special equipment to complete the final preparations on the [[Ram's Head]]. When the [[Ram's Head]] arrives they will transfer to it. This will take about [[ten]] minutes.$ [[Red]] Squadron will send three X-wings to the rendezvous point to protect this transfer. You must ensure that the [[Ram's Head]] makes it to safety.
segment.target: 我們最優秀的技術人員正在巡邏艦[[天秤號]]上等待。他們配有特殊裝備，負責完成對[[公羊角號]]的最後整裝。當[[公羊角號]]抵達時，他們將轉移至艦上。這大約需要[[十分鐘]]。$ [[紅隊]]中隊將派遣三架X翼戰機前往會合點保護此次轉移。你必須確保[[公羊角號]]安全撤離。

segment.source: Thank you, Red One, the Ram's Head is safe
segment.target: 謝謝你，紅隊長，公羊角號安全了

segment.source: Operation Ram's Head will proceed now
